license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

issuing_authority.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested.

name.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested.

type.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested. The board shall consist of eight practicing dentists, two registered dental assistants, and five public members.

umbrella_agency.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested.

age_minimum.quote: Any person over 18 years of age is eligible to take an examination before the board upon making application therefor

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery or Doctor of Dental Medicine from an approved dental college
degree_required.quote: Furnishing satisfactory evidence of having graduated from a dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

degree_level.quote: Furnishing satisfactory evidence of having graduated from a dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association and presenting satisfactory evidence of having completed at dental school or schools the full number of academic years of undergraduate courses required for graduation.

school_approval_basis.quote: dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

credential_pegged.quote: Furnishing satisfactory evidence of having graduated from a dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

required.quote: Notwithstanding Section 1634, the board may grant a license to practice dentistry to an applicant who submits all of the following to the board: ... Satisfactory evidence of having completed a clinically based advanced education program in general dentistry or an advanced education program in general practice residency that is, at minimum, one year in duration

experience_source.quote: A person successfully passing the examination shall be registered as a licensed dentist on the board register, as provided in Section 1612, and shall be granted by the board a license to practice dentistry in the State of California.

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination (written)
exams.notes: Administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: The board shall require each applicant to successfully complete the written examination of the National Board Dental Examination of the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations.

exams.name: California Law and Ethics Examination
exams.notes: Developed and administered by the board; valid for two years
exams.quote: The board shall require each applicant to successfully complete an examination in California law and ethics developed and administered by the board.

exams.name: Clinical examination (Western Regional Examining Board or American Board of Dental Examiners, Inc.)
exams.notes: Applicant must have taken and received a passing score within five years prior to application date; alternative pathway via advanced education program residency also available under Section 1634.1
exams.quote: an applicant who fails to pass the examination required by Section 1632 after three attempts shall not be eligible for further reexamination until the applicant has successfully completed a minimum of 50 hours of education for each subject which the applicant failed

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under the provisions of this chapter, unless specifically excepted, expire at 12 midnight on the legal birth date of a licentiate of the board during the second year of a two-year term if not renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: On and after January 1, 2018, the fee for an initial license shall not exceed eight hundred dollars ($800), and the fee for the renewal of a license shall not exceed eight hundred dollars ($800).

required.quote: All holders of licenses under this chapter shall continue their education after receiving a license as a condition to the renewal thereof, and shall obtain evidence satisfactory to the board that they have, during the preceding two-year period, obtained continuing education relevant to developments in the practice of dentistry and dental assisting consistent with regulations established by the board.

period_years.quote: during the preceding two-year period, obtained continuing education relevant to developments in the practice of dentistry

value: risks of addiction associated with the use of Schedule II drugs
topical_requirements.quote: The board may prescribe this mandatory coursework within the general areas of patient care, health and safety, law and ethics, and the risks of addiction associated with the use of Schedule II drugs. The mandatory coursework prescribed by the board shall not exceed 15 hours per renewal period for dentists

available.quote: Notwithstanding Section 1634, the board may grant a license to practice dentistry to an applicant who has not taken an examination before the board, if the applicant submits all of the following to the board: ... Proof of an active and unrestricted license issued by another state, district, or territory of the United States to practice dentistry

requirements.value: Applicant must hold active unrestricted out-of-state license, have been in active clinical practice for at least five years immediately preceding application (or equivalent), have no disciplinary action history, provide NPDB release, have not failed a licensure exam within five years, provide 50 units of recent CE, and acknowledge no disqualifying criminal convictions.
requirements.quote: Proof of an active and unrestricted license issued by another state, district, or territory of the United States to practice dentistry that is not subject to any current or pending disciplinary action such as revocation, suspension, or probation.

exists.quote: There shall be in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Dental Board of California in which the administration of this chapter is vested. The board shall consist of eight practicing dentists, two registered dental assistants, and five public members.

national_certification.value: American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (for elective facial cosmetic surgery permit applicants)
national_certification.quote: The licensee is certified, or is a candidate for certification, by the American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery.

national_association.quote: dental college approved by the board or by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

credential_type.quote: A person successfully passing the examination shall be registered as a licensed dentist on the board register, as provided in Section 1612, and shall be granted by the board a license to practice dentistry in the State of California.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

title_protection.quote: Assumes the degree of "doctor of dental surgery," "doctor of dental science," or "doctor of dental medicine" or appends the letters "D.D.S.," or "D.D.Sc." or "D.M.D." to their name without having had the right to assume the title conferred upon them by diploma from a recognized dental college or school legally empowered to confer the same.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the practice of dentistry in the state, either privately or as an employee of a governmental agency or political subdivision, unless the person has a valid, unexpired license or special permit from the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing unlicensed or suspended dentists to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employment directly or indirectly of any student or suspended or unlicensed dentist to practice dentistry as defined in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any unlicensed person to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The aiding or abetting of any unlicensed person to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or relations with a patient substantially related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The committing of any act or acts of sexual abuse, misconduct, or relations with a patient that are substantially related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, assumed, or fictitious name in advertising or indicating practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, assumed, or fictitious name, either as an individual, firm, corporation, or otherwise, or any name other than the name under which the person is licensed to practice, in advertising or in any other manner indicating that the person is practicing or will practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting or receiving any commission or rebate in any form for professional services, radiograms, prescriptions, or other services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of accepting or receiving any commission or the rebating in any form or manner of fees for professional services, radiograms, prescriptions, or other services or articles supplied to patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making use of advertising statements of a character tending to deceive or mislead the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making use by the licensee or any agent of the licensee of any advertising statements of a character tending to deceive or mislead the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising professional superiority or performance of services in a superior manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising of either professional superiority or the advertising of performance of professional services in a superior manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or making use of solicitors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing or the making use of solicitors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising to guarantee any dental service or to perform any dental operation painlessly
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising to guarantee any dental service, or to perform any dental operation painlessly.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of laws regulating procurement, dispensing, or administration of dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any of the provisions of law regulating the procurement, dispensing, or administration of dangerous drugs, as defined in Chapter 9 (commencing with Section 4000) or controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Clearly excessive prescribing or administering of drugs or treatment, or excessive use of diagnostic procedures or facilities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The clearly excessive prescribing or administering of drugs or treatment, or the clearly excessive use of diagnostic procedures, or the clearly excessive use of diagnostic or treatment facilities, as determined by the customary practice and standards of the dental profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of threats or harassment against any patient or licensee for providing evidence, or discharging an employee for attempting compliance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of threats or harassment against any patient or licensee for providing evidence in any possible or actual disciplinary action, or other legal action; or the discharge of an employee primarily based on the employee's attempt to comply with the provisions of this chapter or to aid in the compliance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a license by another state or territory on grounds that would be the basis of discipline in California
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a license issued, or discipline imposed, by another state or territory on grounds that would be the basis of discipline in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alteration of a patient's record with intent to deceive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The alteration of a patient's record with intent to deceive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unsanitary or unsafe office conditions as determined by customary dental professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unsanitary or unsafe office conditions, as determined by the customary practice and standards of the dental profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning the patient without written notice and before the patient has opportunity to secure another dentist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The abandonment of the patient by the licensee, without written notice to the patient that treatment is to be discontinued and before the patient has ample opportunity to secure the services of another dentist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud in the procurement of any license issued pursuant to this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud in the procurement of any license issued pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report death or removal to hospital of a patient within seven days as required by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to report to the board in writing within seven days any of the following: (A) the death of the licensee's patient during the performance of any dental or dental hygiene procedure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines, risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases

disciplinary_grounds.description: Utilizing any person to perform licensed dental auxiliary functions who does not possess a current, valid license or permit at the time of initial employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The utilization by a licensed dentist of any person to perform the functions of any registered dental assistant, registered dental assistant in extended functions, dental sedation assistant permitholder, orthodontic assistant permitholder, registered dental hygienist, registered dental hygienist in alternative practice, or registered dental hygienist in extended functions who, at the time of initial employment, does not possess a current, valid license or permit to perform those functions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of dentistry with an expired license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of dentistry with an expired license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct, incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated acts of negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any licentiate may have his license revoked or suspended or be reprimanded or be placed on probation by the board for unprofessional conduct, or incompetence, or gross negligence, or repeated acts of negligence in his or her profession

insurance_required.quote: A holder of a permit issued pursuant to this section shall not perform elective facial cosmetic surgical procedures unless the permitholder has malpractice insurance or other financial security protection that would satisfy the requirements of Section 2216.2 and any regulations adopted thereunder.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A mobile dental unit, or a dental practice that routinely uses portable dental units to provide treatment in nondental office locations, shall be registered and operated in accordance with regulations established by the board.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry is the diagnosis or treatment, by surgery or other method, of diseases and lesions and the correction of malpositions of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures; and such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation.
definition_quote.quote: Dentistry is the diagnosis or treatment, by surgery or other method, of diseases and lesions and the correction of malpositions of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures; and such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation.

value: use of drugs and anesthetic agents
correcting malpositions of human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures
methods_authorized.quote: Dentistry is the diagnosis or treatment, by surgery or other method, of diseases and lesions and the correction of malpositions of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or associated structures; and such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation.

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs as part of dental treatment, including controlled substances subject to DEA registration; may also independently prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines to persons 3 years of age or older.
drug_authority.quote: such diagnosis or treatment may include all necessary related procedures as well as the use of drugs, anesthetic agents, and physical evaluation

value: pediatric endorsement on general anesthesia or moderate sedation permit
elective facial cosmetic surgery permit (oral and maxillofacial surgeons)
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A dentist shall possess an active dentist license or a permit under Section 1638 or 1640 issued by the board and an active general anesthesia permit in order to administer or order the administration of deep sedation or general anesthesia on an outpatient basis for dental patients.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Prior to the issuance or renewal of a permit for the use of deep sedation or general anesthesia, the board may, at its discretion, require an onsite inspection and evaluation of the licentiate and the facility, equipment, personnel, and procedures utilized by the licentiate.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: The failure to report to the board in writing within seven days any of the following: (A) the death of the licensee's patient during the performance of any dental or dental hygiene procedure; (B) the discovery of the death of a patient whose death is related to a dental or dental hygiene procedure performed by the licensee; or (C) except for a scheduled hospitalization, the removal to a hospital or emergency center for medical treatment of any patient to whom oral conscious sedation, conscious sedation, or general anesthesia was administered

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: A dentist shall possess a pediatric endorsement of their general anesthesia permit to administer or order the administration of deep sedation or general anesthesia to patients under seven years of age.

specialist_license_available.quote: Any person meeting all the following eligibility requirements may apply for a special permit: ... Furnishing satisfactory evidence of having been certified as a diplomate of a specialty board

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Every person to whom a special permit is issued shall be entitled to practice in their recognized specialty or discipline at the dental college at which he or she is employed and its affiliated institutions as approved by the board

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means supervision of dental procedures based on instructions given by a licensed dentist, who shall be physically present in the treatment facility during the performance of those procedures. ... "General supervision" means supervision of dental procedures based on instructions given by a licensed dentist but not requiring the physical presence of the supervising dentist during the performance of those procedures.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist shall not concurrently supervise more than a total of five registered dental assistants in extended functions, registered dental hygienists, or registered dental hygienists in alternative practice providing services pursuant to Sections 1753.55, 1910.5, and 1926.05.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: The dental hygiene board shall license as a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice a person who demonstrates satisfactory performance on an examination in California law and ethics required by the dental hygiene board

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice may perform the duties authorized pursuant to subdivision (a) of Section 1907, subdivision (a) of Section 1908, and subdivisions (a) and (b) of Section 1910 in the following settings: (a) Residences of the homebound. (b) Schools. (c) Residential facilities and other institutions and medical settings that a residential facility patient has been transferred to for outpatient services. (d) Dental health professional shortage areas ... (e) Dental offices.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: A mobile dental unit, or a dental practice that routinely uses portable dental units to provide treatment in nondental office locations, shall be registered and operated in accordance with regulations established by the board.

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: These regulations shall require the registrant to identify a licensed dentist responsible for the mobile dental unit or portable practice, and shall include, but shall not be limited to, requirements for availability of followup and emergency care, maintenance and availability of provider and patient records, and treatment information to be provided to patients and other appropriate parties.

approximate.matched_normalized: e regulations shall require the registrant to identify a licensed dentist responsible for the mobile dental unit or portable practice and shall include but shall not be limited to requirements for availability of followup and emergency care maintenance and availability of provider and patient records and treatment information to be provided to patients and other appropriate parties

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: A dental corporation is a corporation that is authorized to render professional services, as defined in Sections 13401 and 13401.5 of the Corporations Code, if that corporation, its shareholders, officers, directors, and employees rendering professional services who are dentists, physicians and surgeons, dental assistants, registered dental assistants, registered dental assistants in extended functions, registered dental hygienists, registered dental hygienists in extended functions, or registered dental hygienists in alternative practice are in compliance with the Moscone-Knox Professional Corporation Act

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: The construction, making, verification of shade taking, alteration or repairing of bridges, crowns, dentures, or other prosthetic appliances, or orthodontic appliances, when the casts or impressions for this work have been made or taken by a licensed dentist, but a written authorization signed by a licensed dentist shall accompany the order for the work

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper or lower denture fabricated by a licensed dentist, or fabricated pursuant to the dentist's work order, shall be marked with the patient's name, unless the patient objects.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: An individual licensed to practice dentistry under this chapter is a licentiate for purposes of paragraph (2) of subdivision (a) of Section 805, and thus is a health care practitioner subject to the provisions of Section 2290.5 pursuant to subdivision (b) of that section.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A registered dental hygienist is authorized to perform the following procedures under direct supervision of a licensed dentist, after submitting to the dental hygiene board evidence of satisfactory completion of a course of instruction, approved by the dental hygiene board, in the procedures: ... (b) Administration of local anesthesia.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A registered dental hygienist is authorized to perform the following procedures under direct supervision of a licensed dentist, after submitting to the dental hygiene board evidence of satisfactory completion of a course of instruction, approved by the dental hygiene board, in the procedures: ... (c) Administration of nitrous oxide and oxygen, whether administered alone or in combination with each other.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: A registered dental assistant in extended functions licensed on or after January 1, 2010, is authorized to perform the following additional procedures under direct supervision and pursuant to the order, control, and full professional responsibility of a licensed dentist: ... Place, contour, finish, and adjust all direct restorations. Adjust and adhere all permanent indirect restorations.

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: "Interim therapeutic restoration" means a direct provisional restoration placed to stabilize the tooth until a licensed dentist diagnoses the need for further definitive treatment. An interim therapeutic restoration consists of the removal of soft material from the tooth using only hand instrumentation, without the use of rotary instrumentation, and subsequent placement of an adhesive restorative material.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dentist shall maintain current certification in Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS).

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: The dental hygiene board shall license as a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice a person who demonstrates satisfactory performance on an examination in California law and ethics required by the dental hygiene board and who completes an application form and pays all application fees required by the dental hygiene board
